about: Scrolling layers for the Gullet backdrop (the game's first world, id hell), in the look of its walls: made with MiniMax image-01 on chroma green so scripts/build-backdrops.py can key, grade and loop them as it does the other worlds'. Each prompt gave two plates, <name>_001.jpg and <name>_002.jpg, kept here as <name>.jpg and <name>_b.jpg: a layer's two sections.
notes: The plates come out with a floor at the bottom of some of them; the build keeps only the rows above it (rows, in WORLDS).
The green is not perfectly even. After the key, the build drops whatever is left thinner than about a third opaque (thin).
The sky is not a plate: the build paints it (pit_sky).
key.jpg is not a plate either: build-backdrops.py hell --key puts it together from the layers.

plates.far: Parallax background layer for a dark horror video game, painted on a solid flat chroma key green background. Seen from far away and exactly front-on: three colossal bridges spanning straight across a tall frame from the left edge to the right edge, one near the top, one in the middle, one near the bottom, each a row of giant rib bones forming arches like a gothic viaduct, grown over with raw flesh, draped with curtains of sinew and long hanging tendrils, with colossal skulls fused into the piers. Between and behind the bridges there is nothing but empty flat pure green. Hyper-detailed modern AAA horror game environment art, photoreal, wet, low-key lighting, dark crimson, dried-blood brown and bone. The green is perfectly flat and even, bright green #00ff00, with no shadows, no gradient, no fog, no ground and no sky. No text.
plates.mid: Parallax background layer for a dark horror video game, painted on a solid flat chroma key green background. Two towering cliffs of raw flesh, one down the whole left edge and one down the whole right edge of a tall frame, running from the top edge to the bottom edge; the middle third of the frame is empty flat pure green. The cliffs are knotted muscle, intestines and sinew ropes with giant screaming skinless faces, clusters of bloodshot eyes, rib cages and skulls fused into them, ragged overhangs, and tendrils and strings of gore hanging in toward the centre. Hyper-detailed modern AAA horror game environment art, photoreal sculpted detail, wet and glistening, low-key lighting from the upper left, deep black shadows, dark crimson, dried-blood brown and bruise purple. The green is perfectly flat and even, bright green #00ff00, with no shadows, no gradient, no fog, no ground and no sky. No text.
plates.near: Foreground parallax layer for a dark horror video game, painted on a solid flat chroma key green background. Close to the camera, down the far left edge and the far right edge of a tall frame from the top edge to the bottom edge: thick wet tendons, ribbed spines, ropes of intestine and dripping strands of sinew, with hooked ribs and a few teeth jutting inward; each side covers less than a quarter of the width and the whole middle of the frame is empty flat pure green. Very dark, almost in silhouette, with wet rim light picking out the edges. Hyper-detailed modern AAA horror game environment art, photoreal, deep black shadows, dark crimson and dried-blood brown. The green is perfectly flat and even, bright green #00ff00, with no shadows, no gradient, no fog, no ground and no sky. No text.
